acceptanceCriteria: corvint-update apply (and the documented install procedure) keeps a bounded rollback set (default: the previous build only) and removes older backups it created.
Rollback still works for the retained set; backups not created by Corvint are never touched.
Test or recorded run showing the count stays bounded across repeated installs.
body: Each install from origin/main backs up six binaries as X.pre-buildN.bak and corvint-update leaves its own .bak; nothing removes older sets. On 2026-10-19 ~/.local/bin held 33 backups across builds 202..673 (968 MB total, 601 MB after keeping only the latest set).
title: Binary install/update keeps every backup: 33 .bak files (~370 MB) accumulated in ~/.local/bin
